description: Universal aroma descriptor tree for a multi-category tasting app (wine, coffee, beer, tea, cheese, chocolate, spirits, food). Three tiers: family (tier1) -> subfamily (tier2) -> leaf (tier3). Placement follows perception, not origin. Each leaf has one home. Faults are neutral descriptors. Modifiers are orthogonal state-transformations stored separately as (aroma_id, modifier_id); the tree holds base descriptors in fresh/default state only, and each node declares which modifiers may attach.

conventions.id_scheme: tier1 = family key; tier2 = family.subfamily; tier3 = family.subfamily.leaf
conventions.modifier_inheritance: A modifier attached at a leaf also aggregates at that leaf's subfamily and family.
conventions.allowed_modifiers_field: Per node. If a node omits it, it inherits its parent's allowed set. Leaf-level lists override.
conventions.promoted_leaves: base+modifier combos that became distinct enough to be their own leaf (e.g. raisin, prune) are listed as leaves and carry no redundant modifier.
conventions.fresh_is_implicit: The 'fresh' state is the default and is never selected or shown.
conventions.modifier_display: Optional per-leaf override of a modifier's displayed word. Absent -> use the modifier's default label. Data still stores (aroma_id, modifier_id); this only changes the shown badge word. e.g. malt+roasted shows 'toasted', strawberry+cooked shows 'jammy', onion+cooked shows 'stewed'.

families.label: Vegetal
families.note: Fresh/raw green plant matter, herbs and fresh vegetables. Cured/cooked/dried plant notes route elsewhere via family or modifier.

families.label: Spice
families.note: Aromatic spices. Chili HEAT is a structure axis (Spiciness), not an aroma leaf; chili as a smell can appear as a leaf.

leaves.label: chili (aroma)
leaves.note: smell only; heat = Spiciness structure axis

families.label: Sweet
families.note: Aromatic sweetness (the smell), not the Sweetness taste axis. Includes cooked/sweetened dairy.

subfamilies.label: Sweet dairy
subfamilies.note: Cooked / sweetened dairy; plain and cultured dairy live in Savory.

subfamilies.label: Grain / Cereal
subfamilies.note: Raw/kilned cereal + malt. Roasted versions (chocolate malt, roasted barley) reached via the roasted modifier.

families.label: Fire
families.note: Notes whose identity is roast/toast/smoke/char. Distinct from the roasted/smoked/burnt modifiers.

subfamilies.label: Dry-aged organic
subfamilies.note: Leather placed here (dry cigar-box perception), not Funky/animal.

subfamilies.label: Tobacco
subfamilies.note: Unlit is the base state; lit/smoked reached via the smoked modifier.

families.label: Mineral
families.note: Inorganic + earthy (nested) + saline. Petrol lives in Chemical; flint lives here.

families.label: Savory
families.note: Umami core + savory/plain dairy + cheese. Olive here (cured, not fresh).

leaves.label: bacon
leaves.note: cured+smoked reads as its own leaf

subfamilies.label: Dairy / cheese
subfamilies.note: Plain and cultured dairy + all cheese. Cooked/sweet dairy = Sweet; blue cheese = Funky.

families.label: Funky
families.note: Prized fermentation / animal notes. Named neutrally; context + spread decide good/bad.

subfamilies.label: Cheese-funk
subfamilies.note: The mould percept; all other cheese is Savory.

families.label: Chemical
families.note: Off-notes, named neutrally (no fault flag). Petrol here. Kept neutral because one category's fault is another's character.

leaves.label: catty / cat pee
leaves.note: thiol; varietal in Sauvignon, fault elsewhere

subfamilies.label: Taint / spoilage
subfamilies.note: Kept neutral, no fault flag (open decision: some are near-always spoilage).
